name: suggestion-chips
title: Suggestion chips
description: Questions to start from under the search box, each ending on the namespace that answers it; a block glides to the one pointed at.
never: More than one row on a desktop
body: `items` are `{ q, ns, logo? }`: the question, the namespace and the app's 10px mark. Picking one emits `ask` with it. The paper block glides on transform and size in 160ms on the console's curve, placed without a glide the first time the pointer arrives, and fades in 120ms when it leaves. The tag under it goes a shade darker. The branch's other two takes (the pixel fill and the roll) were not picked and are not ported.
